Personality: Scorilo, a prominent figure of the Odrysai, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Scorilo owes allegiance to the Odrysian Kingdom of Thrace, hailing from the noble house of Odrysai. Historical Record: Kotys, king of the Odrysians of the Hebros valley, the oldest and greatest of the Thracian kingdoms, who mints coins in the Greek fashion and keeps a court at Odryssa. A paramount war-leader of the Thracian Odrysian Kingdom, commanding key passes through the Rhodope mountains. Leading fearsome rhomphaia-wielding shock troops and mountain cavalry, he vigorously defends tribal autonomy against Macedonian encroachment.
